title: A plan change dated on a period's first day applies to that period (V, corrected reading)
story: Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026, pay day: the bank holds 400,000, of which Food 40,000 and Free to spend 60,000 (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). Fri 8 Jan 2027 the pay is ticked (pay@2027-01-10; 10 Jan is a Sunday): a new period starts that day. The same day the person lowers Free to spend to 50,000 a month and raises Food to 45,000 a month (changes made Fri 8 Jan). Sat 9 Jan: 2,000 from Free to spend and 3,000 on Food. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening, typed; the change is not made yet) = 60,000

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 50,000 (Free to spend for the period from Fri 8 Jan: the change was made on its first day, so it applies to it) - 2,000 (Sat 9 Jan) = 48,000
asks.note: Before the corrected reading the change applied from the next period start: 58,000.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 400,000 (opening) + 300,000 (pay, Fri 8 Jan) - 2,000 (Sat 9 Jan) - 3,000 (Sat 9 Jan) - 42,000 (Food left this period: 45,000, the new amount from this period's first day, less 3,000) = 653,000
asks.note: Before the corrected reading Food kept 40,000 this period: 658,000.
